# Synthetic test fixture (safe content)

This file is a synthetic, deliberately harmless fixture used by
tests/test_cli.py to exercise the Cerbero scanner CLI entry point
against a clean target. It is written to avoid every pattern the
scanner is designed to catch.

If a test ever needs a hostile payload (encoded text, invisible
characters, HTML comments with instructions, and so on), that payload
belongs inline inside the test file, built with chr() or escape
sequences at runtime. Nothing like that should be committed as a
fixture file in this repository.

Example neutral content follows, a short grocery list:

- oranges
- bread
- rice
- coffee beans
- olive oil

End of fixture.
